result: resolved for tables and HTML paragraphs; tabs need a gpui decision (recorded for the user)
fixes: tables: map gap 2b. Upstream's table frame (U:text/node.rs:3269-3276), scroll row track (:3180) and actions row (:3183-3194) are plain divs, Block under 0.2.2; the port used gpui.Div() (Flex in the pin), so rows went onto one line. They now use textBlockDiv()

scrollable views: each list item is laid out as a root; upstream's Block roots fill the list width, Flex roots shrank to content (HTML tables, code-block backgrounds). renderRoot wraps each item in a full-width textBlockDiv().WFull() (U:text/document.rs:189-245)

HTML paragraphs: upstream gives every keyless text paragraph the id "p" (U:text/node.rs:2505-2507) and HTML nodes have no spans (format/html.rs), so InlineFlow paragraphs under one parent shared one stored layout (U:text/inline_flow.rs:80-98) and the last rendered won (the <pre> code paragraph painted over the earlier one). Deliberate deviation: nodeRenderContext.leafElementID numbers keyless paragraphs in render order within each top-level block; paragraphs with a span keep upstream's id

tabs.finding: upstream Base does nothing special with tabs (TabSize only drives indent insertion, input/editor/indent.rs:13-43); the pin shapes with parley/harfrust and emits every glyph without a control-character filter (gpui_ce_parley text_system.rs:1273-1285), so \t paints the missing glyph; Base's 0.2.2 line used DirectWrite IDWriteTextLayout (gpui_windows direct_write.rs:554), which renders a tab as blank space at a tab stop. Measured offscreen: a tab shapes to one space width (Consolas 14px: 'a\tb' = 'a b' = 23.09px) but paints the missing-glyph box
tabs.decision_for_user: fixing it means gpui shaping/painting draws nothing for \t (and optionally advances to a tab stop), diverging from the pin toward 0.2.2
